stick_the_smith_chart_the_cayley_transfo.question: The Smith chart - the Cayley transform
references: P. Smith's impedance chart (1939) - Gamma = (Z - Z0)/(Z + Z0)
the Cayley transform between self-adjoint and unitary operators
the conformal map of the half-plane onto the disk
stick_the_smith_chart_the_cayley_transfo.statement: Gamma = (z - 1)/(z + 1) maps the passive-impedance half-plane (Re z >= 0) into the unit disk and the lossless imaginary axis onto the unit circle |Gamma| = 1. It is the Cayley transform; the operator form (A - iI)(A + iI)^-1 sends a self-adjoint A to a unitary U, the real spectrum to the unit circle.

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Smith chart / Cayley transform, 2026-10-07
ticks.claim: [matched load -> center] z = 1 gives Gamma = (1-1)/(1+1) = 0 (sealed): a perfectly matched load sits at the center of the chart, |Gamma| = 0, no reflection. The fixed point of the transform.

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Smith chart / Cayley transform, 2026-10-07
ticks.claim: [short -> the circle] z = 0 (a short) gives Gamma = (0-1)/(0+1) = -1 (sealed): on the unit circle, total reflection. Open and short sit at opposite points of |Gamma| = 1.

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Smith chart / Cayley transform, 2026-10-07
ticks.claim: [lossless -> the unit circle, the key] z = i (pure reactance) gives |Gamma|^2 = ((-1)^2 + 1^2)/(1^2 + 1^2) = 2/2 = 1 (sealed), so |Gamma| = 1. EVERY lossless impedance - the whole imaginary axis - maps onto the unit circle. This is self-adjoint (spectrum on the line) <-> unitary (spectrum on the circle) in the engineer's hand: the same line<->circle symmetry that pins |alpha| = sqrt(q) over a finite field (stick_finite_field_riemann) and that Hilbert-Polya would use (stick_hilbert_polya).

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Smith chart / Cayley transform, 2026-10-07
ticks.claim: [why this belongs in the Riemann arc] The Smith chart is a conformal MAP; the critical line Re(s) = 1/2 and the unit circle are two faces of one symmetry under Cayley. The engine is not an RF simulator and does not run electromagnetics; it seals the transform's arithmetic and keeps the likeness as discernment. map, never launder.
